primary.title: Income Tax Act, 2025: NRI tax residency in India—182-day stay rule, ₹15 lakh threshold and ITR exemption condition
primary.summary: Living abroad does not automatically make you a non-resident for Indian tax purposes. Residency depends on the number of days spent in India, income and other conditions. Know about the 182-day and 120-day tests, deemed residency, ITR exemptions and the transition to the Income Tax Act, 2025.
